notes: The dual's shapes as data (NP_01 s2 canonical structure, s3.3 tiebreak ladder, s6 condition carry, s8 alternate formats). 'dressed' is the roster each side brings; 'segments' the slots; a roster shorter than the slots repeats (repeat_slots) and a fighter who re-enters carries stamina, guard and composure from the segment he left (condition_carries). sudden_death is the R6 Golden DROP at the bottom of the ladder. blind: no reveals. exhibition_2v2 (s8) is the one simultaneous format and no rotation: 'simultaneous' - both dressed in the ring at once for its one segment, one engagement per pair (sim/exhibition.gd, PAC-088); 'sync_ms' is NP_05 s7's duo window (both inputs within it), 'partner_answer_ms' when an AI partner answers it, 'manager_duo_bar' the bar at which two delegated fighters call it (the profile's opening).
